meaning: Explosion diameter / lifetime index (decimal 27.). NOTE physical line 225; skeleton mis-cited :111 (its logical line).
Peak blast radius = OLDRAD table maximum (rising half ends at 13.)

OLDRAD radius-vs-time table, rising half (indices 0..13): holds 0 for two steps, SKIPS 1, then climbs to the peak 13 (trailing . = decimal; bare 0-9 hex == decimal). A byte-exact citation anchor — the decoded table lives in blastRadius (explosion.ts) and is pinned by explosion.test.ts's source-ground-truth decode; value is the 'cite' kind tag so no table byte leaks into the un-cited-literal guard.

OLDRAD radius-vs-time table, falling half (indices 14..28): holds 13 one more step (the peak plateau) then collapses 13->...->1->0, carrying a lone 1 the rise never had. Second .BYTE row, after the double-spaced blank at 1918. A byte-exact citation anchor; value is the 'cite' kind tag.

Game frames per OLDRAD index step. PREXPL splits the explosion slots into round-robin batches via EXPFIX (a 6-byte table) and advances one batch per frame, so a single blast's index moves once every (EXPEND-EXPFIX-2)+1 = 5 frames.
